name: arcosian-vendors
description: Vendor MCP adapter for arcosian: PixelLab, Meshy, ElevenLabs hosted MCP, plus Scenario and ComfyUI notes, with a skill on when to use a vendor MCP versus the core studio-gateway and how to keep provenance and budgets intact.

pixellab_api_key.title: PixelLab API token
pixellab_api_key.description: Bearer token for the PixelLab remote MCP at api.pixellab.ai/mcp. A PixelLab subscription is required.

meshy_api_key.title: Meshy API key
meshy_api_key.description: MESHY_API_KEY for the Meshy MCP server. The key requires a Pro plan or above.
